title: In Gogs 0.14.3, the Git Smart HTTP authorization layer in internal/route/repo/http.go allows a push when only read…
description: In Gogs version 0.14.3, a vulnerability exists in the Git Smart HTTP authorization layer where a push operation is allowed despite the user having only read access. This is due to inconsistent case-sensitive checks on the HTTP verb, leading to improper authorization. This issue is distinct from CVE-2026-52810.
